design_notes: ≥3 archetypes: brake pads, suspension, exhaust, brake lines, BBK, lift kit, downpipe, strut bar
≥1 explicitly relational query (all relational queries name a vehicle)
Queries target each of 3 dropped products (title_only, zero inferred vehicles) AND each retained control
Non-relational (intrinsic) queries included as controls — no vehicle named
Population split: dropped = recall=0 in Stage 1 (inferred empty); retained = recall>0 in Stage 1
Four-way field presence: title_only / specs_only / both / neither — recorded per query-product pair

dropped.title: 27WON Performance Brake Pads for 2017+ Honda Civic Si / 2023+ Acura Integra
PRL Motorsports 4-Piston BBK + Paragon Upgrade Kit for 2017+ Honda Civic Si/Integra [FC/FE/DE4]
HEL Performance Stainless Steel Braided Brake Lines for 2022+ Honda Civic Si [FE1]

retained.title: Eibach Sportline Kit for 2022+ Honda Civic Type R [FL5]
Whiteline Adjustable Rear Upper Camber Arms for 2016+ Honda Civic (Pair) [FC/FK/FE/FL]
ICON Stage 4 Lift Kit CDCV for 2021-2024 Ford F-150 4WD
BR Series Coilovers for 2016-2021 Honda Civic Non-Si Coupe / Sedan
27WON Front Strut Tower Bar for 2022+ Honda Civic/2023+ Acura Integra - Black
27WON Performance Valved Exhaust System for 2023+ Honda Civic Type R [FL5]
High Efficiency Downpipe Upgrade for 2017+, 2023+ Honda Civic Type R FK8 FL5 2.0T & 2024+ Acura Integra Type S 2.0T DE5

queries.query: brake pads for 2018 Honda Civic Si
queries.rationale: Relational query targeting the dropped 27WON pads and retained Paragon pads. The vehicle is named explicitly.
Relational query targeting the dropped 27WON pads (title names Acura Integra). Tests whether the dropped vehicle in tech_specs affects retrieval.

Intrinsic control — no vehicle named. All brake pad products should be retrievable on this query regardless of fitment. Tests whether dropped-relational products are retrievable when the query doesn't require the relational attribute.

queries.query: brake kit for 2018 Honda Civic Si
queries.rationale: Relational query with broader phrasing targeting both dropped products that name Civic Si.

queries.query: brake lines for 2022 Honda Civic Si
queries.rationale: Relational query targeting the dropped HEL brake lines. Title names Honda Civic Si but tech_specs has zero vehicles.
Intrinsic control for HEL brake lines — no vehicle named. Tests whether the product is retrievable without the relational attribute.
